type.Description: BIDS has no type for penetrating silicon-probe sites; SEEG (intracortical depth recording) is used. These are Neuropixels probe sites.

low_cutoff.Description: SpikeGLX LF band-pass lower edge (Dryad methods: 0.5-500 Hz).

source_channel_name.Description: NWB electrodes.channel_name (NeuroConv names the shared electrode rows after the AP band, AP<k>; the LF channel k is named LF<k> here).

source_electrode_row.Description: Row of the NWB electrodes table referenced by the LFP series.

inter_sample_shift.Description: NWB electrodes.inter_sample_shift: Neuropixels ADC multiplexing delay of the channel as a fraction of the sampling period (not corrected in the data).
